fields.Requirement: The default Riposte Sorter applies categories when supported by saved rules or bounded filename proposals; absent, unknown or ambiguous matches continue through ordinary Year/Month/img-or-vid/Size routing. Sorting applies only a read-only exact destination preview bound to current sources, rules, catalogs and options. Reusable rules match trusted original titles; old generated names are not guessed and optional manual assignments remain available. Stable image/video identities and private titles/assignments survive repeat sorts and are restored by exact undo, including interrupted work. CLI, terminal and browser/API preserve explicit consent, no-overwrite collisions, Unicode categories, legacy catalogs, date-only image metadata and unchanged video bytes. Exact case-insensitive _float_ and __float__ directories are excluded from sorting only; standalone RIPOSTE remains available.
